newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists get 205 bln lire of Italy 3,5-yr BTPs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists get 205 bln lire of Italy 3,5-yr BTPs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders were allocated 200 billion lire worth of three-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against bids for 272 billion and the Italian Treasury's offer of 200 billion lire of paper.
They also bid for and were allocated five billion lire worth of five-year BTPs against a Treasury offer of 150 billion lire worth.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 4.733 trillion lire at the open auction for the Feb 15, 2000 paper, against 2.0 trillion lire worth of three-year BTPs on offer.
The auction price was set at 97.55 from 98.70 and gross yield at 7.04 percent from 6.58 percent at the previous auction on February 28.
The Treasury received bids for 2.757 trillion lire of the March 1, 2002 BTPs against an offer of 1.5 trillion lire.
The assigned price was 96.50 percent against 98.15 on February 28 with gross yield of 7.22 against 6.80 percent.
